component_blueprints.Hero: Fullscreen section (min-h-screen). Background: dark mesh gradient and particles. Center aligned Flexbox. Framer motion staggered text reveal for 'FLAMUR AHMETI'.
component_blueprints.ProjectCard: div with rounded-2xl, border-white/10, bg-white/5. Hover group: translates up slightly, reveals glowing border. Includes Title, one-line desc, and external links.
component_blueprints.TechBadge: Pill shape (rounded-full), text-sm text-zinc-300, bg-white/5 border border-white/10. Hover: bg-white/10.
component_blueprints.MagneticButton: Custom Framer Motion component. Wraps standard button. Tracks mouse offset to apply slight spring-based transform. Primary CTA uses white bg with black text for high contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install '@fontsource/geist-sans' and '@fontsource/geist-mono' and import them in index.css.
Build a one-page seamless scroll experience in App.js.
Implement the mouse-following radial gradient using a fixed pointer event listener and Framer Motion for the background glow.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use a dark theme explicitly: background '#050505', text colors in the 'zinc' scale. Set global body background in index.css.
Add global CSS in index.css for the subtle animated background mesh and text-selection styles (e.g., bg-white/20).
Make the website fully responsive. Hero text must shrink gracefully on mobile.
For the Hero roles, use Framer Motion AnimatePresence to cycle through them or list them cleanly separated by ' • '.
